This '''unidentified [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer''' was a student at the [[Corulag Academy]]. He worked on [[Aleq Armond]]'s enhanced [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] project which was intended to improve the speed of the Empire's [[TIE series/Legends|TIE fighters]]. The student served as a spy for the Rebel Alliance and informed them that, if the public demonstration of the new ion engine system were to fail, the project was bound to be abandoned.<ref name="Into the Core Worlds">{{JournalCite|7|Into the Core Worlds}}</ref>

In order to protect the student from harm, the Alliance dispatched a team of operatives who sabotaged the demonstration, causing the new ion engine engine not to be implemented.<ref name="Into the Core Worlds" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character appears in an adventure idea in ''[[Into the Core Worlds]]'' and, while the character remains unidentified, it is obviously significant in an in-universe perspective, playing a pivotal role in the development of TIE fighter technology.<ref name="Into the Core Worlds" />
